method: REA open_binary identified the JAR; inspect_artifact was rejected by the client approval policy. Selected XML bytes were parsed with Python zipfile/ElementTree; these parsed findings are ordinary artifact observations, not REA Evidence.
limitations: Static scheme values do not establish runtime placement or hover behavior.
Wavy shape and diagnostic popup composition are reconstructed from the user screenshot and current native API. No IntelliJ inspection engine or quick-fix behavior is implemented.
